warranty.title: What standards can we meet?

cases.question: If composition must be verified
cases.title: Mill certificates + third-party test on request.
cases.description: Composition reports and restricted-substance testing arranged before bulk approval when your program requires it.

cases.question: If color shifts in bulk
cases.title: Written tolerance and re-dip policy.
cases.description: Lab dip approval defines acceptable delta. Out-of-tolerance rolls are flagged before shipment — not after arrival.

cases.question: If rolls arrive short
cases.title: Roll report reconciles meters vs. PO.
cases.description: Every roll is measured at final inspection. Shortage claims are resolved against the signed inspection report.
